column1: # Clojure. A definition is a defining form at the top level of the file, or directly inside a
#   ns -> package; defn, defn-, defmacro, defmulti -> function; def, defonce -> variable;
#   defmethod -> method (named by the multimethod; the dispatch value is not part of the name);
#   defprotocol, definterface -> interface, each method signature inside -> method;
# A form that opens with its own metadata (^:cljs (def x)) counts like any other.
# Not definitions: a def inside a defn, let or (comment ...), declare, deftest, protocol implementations inside
# defrecord, deftype, extend-protocol and reify, calls such as println.
